[engine] A diagnostic must be shown to print before its silence is read as a finding: zero lines and 'nothing to report' are indistinguishable in a log.

<!-- generated by harness_engine/build_memories.py from traces/lessons.jsonl -->
<!-- lesson_id: eng-diag-0013 | class: diagnosis | superseded_by: - -->

**class**: `diagnosis`

## 為什麼（because）

GGML_SCHED_DEBUG=1's '## SPLIT' lines go through GGML_LOG_DEBUG and were filtered by the default verbosity (INFO), so the log had 0 of them. One probe run measured nothing, and the two possible readings ('only one split' vs 'the dump was suppressed') imply opposite conclusions.
